title: Stalkwise finite Tor dimension of a scheme morphism
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Say that f has stalkwise finite Tor dimension if for every $x\in X$ there is $n\in\mathbb N$ such that $\operatorname{Tor}^{\mathcal O_{Y,f(x)}}_i(\mathcal O_{X,x},M)=0$ [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules] for every $\mathcal O_{Y,f(x)}$-module M and every $i>n$. The scalar action is induced by the stalk homomorphism of f. For a finite type morphism over a Noetherian scheme this is the perfectness criterion of Stacks Lemma 37.61.11.
